source_text:
Blue Tokai Easy Pour - 20-second YouTube ad.

Objective: drive first-time online purchases of Blue Tokai Easy Pour. Feature the
Mixed Bag so people new to specialty coffee can try roasts ranging from light to
dark. bluetokaicoffee.com

Target audience: coffee drinkers in India who want specialty coffee at home or at
work without buying brewing equipment. Busy professionals who already buy cafe
coffee or drink instant coffee at home and are curious about easy pour-over.

Core message: Specialty coffee. Just a mug and hot water. Show the Easy Pour
filter clipped to a mug, the water hitting the grounds, and the finished cup. The
filter is built into the sachet, so the demo makes the benefit visible.

Call to action: Shop Easy Pour. Pair the CTA with the Mixed Bag pack and the Blue
Tokai logo on the end card.
title: Blue Tokai Easy Pour - specialty coffee, just a mug and hot water
objective: Drive first-time online purchases of Blue Tokai Easy Pour by making the built-in-filter brewing benefit visible in 20 seconds.
audience: Indian coffee drinkers who want specialty coffee at home or work without buying brewing equipment; busy professionals who already buy cafe coffee or instant coffee and are curious about easy pour-over. Supplied by the brief; not independently audience-tested.
subject: Easy Pour single-serve specialty coffee
series_pattern: one 20-second YouTube hero; optional 9:16 Shorts cut later
constraints: Show the filter clipped to a mug, water hitting the grounds and a finished cup
Feature the Mixed Bag and the light-to-dark roast range
End card pairs the CTA with the Mixed Bag pack and Blue Tokai logo
Captions must work with sound off
No price or promotion unless approved exact data exists
Paid asset generation belongs to Level 2, not Level 1
avoid: showing equipment the product does not need
using public product images as if they were licensed advertising assets
implying a real-time brew when the film compresses time
assumptions: 16:9 YouTube in-stream is the primary placement; a 9:16 Shorts cut is optional.
The supplied audience and core message are treated as brief inputs, not research findings.
The budget cap is an operator planning assumption because the brief gives none.
The 20-second film compresses a brew that the brand says needs a short steep.
Public logo and product images are observed references; advertising rights are pending.
Inter is used as a documented placeholder until Blue Tokai supplies its brand typeface.
rights_notes: Blue Tokai owns the logo, packs and product photography. Public availability is not an advertising licence. Demonstration footage needs a performer/hand release. Music and voice need licences.

must_have.text: Open on specialty coffee and the product within the first three seconds
Show the built-in filter clipped to a mug and water hitting the grounds
Feature the Mixed Bag and the light-to-dark roast range
End on the Blue Tokai logo, Mixed Bag pack and Shop Easy Pour CTA
Captions carry the message with sound off
Use only approved product facts, price and promotion
Do not call Easy Pour instant coffee or imply it needs equipment
